description: Shared preset for a Jarvis instance repository: extend it from the instance's renovate.json as github>OWNER/jarvis//renovate/instance.json#<core tag>. It opens one PR per pin an env holds: the core release tag, k3s and Flux. Nothing merges on its own.

packageRules.description: A core release moves cluster-vars core_git_ref and the core GitRepository in flux/sync.yaml together, per env. Read that release's Upgrading notes in CHANGELOG.md before merging.
prBodyNotes: Follow this release's **Upgrading** notes in core's `CHANGELOG.md`, then run operator commands from a checkout of the new tag.

packageRules.description: k3s changes only after approval in the dependency dashboard. k3s_sha256 is bumped by hand in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: Set `k3s_sha256` to the `k3s` line of the release's `sha256sum-amd64.txt` in this PR.

customManagers.description: The core tag an env pins: core_git_ref in values/cluster-vars.yaml, after core_git_repo_url.
The same pin on the core GitRepository in flux/sync.yaml.
k3s version in an env's cluster-vars.yaml.
Flux distribution version in an env's FluxInstance. Merge only once the Flux Operator version the env's core tag ships supports it.
